# Selectt - Certified Pre-Owned Car Marketplace

> Selectt is India's premium trusted platform for certified used cars, free doorstep test drives, transparent pricing, 200-point inspection guarantees, and seamless financing.

## Core Services

- [Browse Certified Cars](https://selectt.in/cars): Search and filter verified pre-owned cars by budget, brand, fuel type, and location.
- [Sell Your Car](https://selectt.in/sell-car): Get an instant AI valuation and doorstep vehicle inspection with same-day payment.
- [Used Car Loans](https://selectt.in/used-car-loan): Instant EMI calculator and competitive used car financing options.
- [Selectt Assured Guarantee](https://selectt.in/selectt-assured): Our 200-point inspection checklist, 1-year warranty, and 5-day money-back guarantee.
- [E-Challan Check](https://selectt.in/e-challan): Verify and check vehicle traffic violation records and challan status.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://selectt.in/faqs): Comprehensive buyer and seller questions answered.
- [Contact Support](https://selectt.in/contact): Connect with our automotive experts and offline hub locations.

## Optional Documentation

- [Privacy Policy](https://selectt.in/privacy-policy): User privacy and data protection details.
